task.description: Review the diff on branch feature/WF02-REQ419-20260927 (`git diff origin/main...HEAD`) against your four standard questions (idiomatic vs. crutch, supervision integrity, type-safety gaps, scope creep) and docs/anti-patterns.md. FAIL if a genuine crutch, scope creep, or a violated tier constraint is found; otherwise PASS with any non-blocking notes recorded.

result.diff_reviewed: git diff origin/main...HEAD (95 files, apps/mobile/ scaffold + docs/mobile/README.md update + handoff/design artifacts)

findings.idiomatic_vs_crutch: PASS. lib/ layout (apps/mobile/lib/{bootstrap,auth,api,definitions,renderers/{form,list,process,task},features,design_system,i18n,shared}) matches docs/mobile/architecture.md §2 exactly. The renderer registry (lib/renderers/renderer_registry.dart) has zero renderer entries registered (correct for REQ-419 -- the four renderer kinds are REQ-426..428's scope) but its build() method has a real branch: unregistered/unknown definitionType always returns UnsupportedDefinitionTypeWidget, a Center with an explicit Key and visible text ('Unsupported definition type: $definitionType'), never Container()/SizedBox.shrink(). test/widgets/renderer_registry_fallback_test.dart is a real widget test (pumpWidget + finds the key/text), not a stub. All auth.dart/api.dart/form.dart/list.dart/process.dart/task.dart/shared.dart/etc. files are inert placeholders (a doc comment plus `library;`, no logic) -- no crutch, no premature implementation.
findings.supervision: N/A for this diff as scoped by the handoff -- pure apps/mobile/ Dart/Flutter code, no lib/letflow/process_instance.ex or instance_supervisor.ex touched. Confirmed no changes under lib/ (backend) in the diff.
findings.type_safety_gaps: None found worth filing. DefinitionWidgetBuilder is a typed function signature (BuildContext, Map<String,dynamic>) -> Widget; RendererRegistry is a small typed class. No invalid-state class introduced that a struct/enum change would make unrepresentable -- the registry's only 'invalid state' (unknown definitionType) is already handled by a real fallback, not a runtime crash.
findings.scope_creep: PASS, held tightly to REQ-419's BUILDS list. Checked for: no auth flow code (auth.dart is an inert placeholder, flutter_appauth wiring is manifest-level plumbing only, not OIDC logic), no webview/scripting runtime (pubspec.yaml dependencies are exactly go_router/flutter_riverpod/dio/flutter_appauth/flutter_secure_storage/intl -- Isar/local-cache explicitly deferred to REQ-423 per pubspec.yaml's own comment), no tenant identifier compiled in (tenant_identifier_guard_test.dart's real-tree test passes, self-test proves the checker fires on 'bpm-default'). app.dart ships exactly one placeholder route (SlugEntryPlaceholderScreen) with no fetch/auth, consistent with REQ-421 being where the real bootstrap sequence lands.
findings.manifestPlaceholders_judgment: Legitimate build-plumbing, not scope creep. android/app/build.gradle.kts sets manifestPlaceholders["appAuthRedirectScheme"] = "com.bizdala.letflow" -- this is the app's own fixed bundle-id-derived redirect scheme (per REQ-418's Keycloak client registration), required only because flutter_appauth's own AndroidManifest.xml declares an intent-filter placeholder that fails the manifest merge if unresolved. It is not tenant-specific (same value for every tenant, every build), contains no auth logic (no OIDC flow code added), and is necessary for `flutter build apk --debug` to succeed with the dependency already mandated by decisions/0012. Correctly commented in the file as 'no auth logic is added here -- REQ-421 implements the actual OIDC flow.'

tier_constraints_check.tenant_agnostic_build: PASS. No per-tenant code or assets found; manifestPlaceholders value is the app's own scheme, not a tenant identifier; tenant_identifier_guard_test.dart's real-tree assertion passes and its self-test proves the check is live, not decorative.
tier_constraints_check.no_general_scripting_runtime_on_device: PASS. forbidden_dependencies_guard_test.dart forbids flutter_js/webview_flutter/flutter_inappwebview by exact name plus lua/wasm/cel by substring, checked against both pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock; pubspec.yaml's actual dependency list contains none of these. No CEL evaluator (REQ-294) or scripting engine present in this diff -- correctly deferred.
tier_constraints_check.no_offline_write_queue: PASS. No local cache/persistence dependency added (Isar explicitly deferred to REQ-423), no queue/write-buffer code anywhere in the diff. api.dart and definitions.dart are inert placeholders.

findings.anti_patterns_md_check: No mobile/Flutter-specific entries exist yet in docs/anti-patterns.md (grep for mobile|flutter found nothing) -- nothing to check against; not a gap, this is the first mobile-tier requirement.

non_blocking_notes: Three static guards (module boundary, forbidden dependencies, tenant identifier) are all genuine fail-the-build checks with a passing self-test proving each fires on a real violation fixture -- this is a good pattern worth reusing verbatim for future static-guard requirements in this tier, not busywork grepping.

docs/anti-patterns.md has no mobile-tier section yet; once a real Flutter mistake surfaces (MOBILE-DEV or a later reviewer), it should get its own entry there rather than only living in a handoff record.
